text.autoconfig.areaautominer.option.mov: Ticks to wait for movement to stabilize
text.autoconfig.areaautominer.option.max: Max air blocks skipped per tick while searching for the next target
Max time (ticks) to reach the target position
Cumulative ticks of negligible movement before being considered stuck
Max time (ticks) to break a single block
Hard timeout for one facing turn (ticks, 20 = 1 second)
Prevents endless loops when constantly disturbed (e.g. holding the mouse)
text.autoconfig.areaautominer.option.sel: Max raycast distance (blocks) when selecting points with a sword
text.autoconfig.areaautominer.option.max: Max squared horizontal distance from player feet to target block center
Default 20.25 (=4.5 blocks, matches vanilla survival reach)
text.autoconfig.areaautominer.option.arr: Horizontal distance threshold (XZ) to consider the target reached
text.autoconfig.areaautominer.option.max: Max vertical distance between player eyes and target block
text.autoconfig.areaautominer.option.pat: Max vanilla A* pathfinding range (blocks); chunk cache radius = max(16, min(64, value))
Too small fails for distant targets, too large hurts performance
text.autoconfig.areaautominer.option.max: Max retries before skipping a block after walking failures
text.autoconfig.areaautominer.option.min: Pause mining when remaining durability drops below this (0 disables)
text.autoconfig.areaautominer.option.fac: Angle deviation below this (deg) counts as aligned, mining starts immediately
Smaller is more precise but increases facing time
text.autoconfig.areaautominer.option.reF: Interrupt mining and re-face when deviation exceeds this (deg)
text.autoconfig.areaautominer.option.ena: Enable rollback detection; disabling improves performance but may miss server rollbacks
text.autoconfig.areaautominer.option.max: Max rescans when rollback is detected (0 disables rescan, same as disabling detection)
Max recorded mined positions; beyond this, recording stops and detection covers only recorded part
